label: FastH3 8-Step V2 T2V+A (distilled)
semantics: Distilled checkpoint with trained VSA sparsity -- a lossy class under this benchmark's policy, compared as its own case because every framework serves the SAME checkpoint under the contract it declares in fastvideo_inference.json: eight DiT forwards on the rungs [999, 874, 749, 624, 500, 375, 250, 125], video/audio shift 10/3, guidance 1, 80% VSA sparsity at 64-token tiles. Not part of the lossless headline. This is the few-step, four-GPU regime where per-request fixed cost (text encode, VAE decode, MP4 encode) is a large share of latency, which the 50-step two-GPU H3 case cannot show.
prompt: At night, while their owner sleeps in a bedroom, three cats march in loudly playing tiny brass instruments, then abruptly file out.
_note: num_inference_steps counts model evaluations (8), as vLLM-Omni does; sglang counts sigma grid points, so its request carries 9 -- the same eight forwards. Both engines reject any other step count or shift for this checkpoint. Both engines pin revision 71a17d72c58c (2026-09-15 14:57): the next and current revision 3da2ddfe (15:05) removed provenance.json, which vLLM-Omni's V2 loader (#7610, merged 09-17) reads to find the base-H3 VAEs, so the current revision fails there with FileNotFoundError. The weights are identical across the two revisions. guidance_scale goes to vLLM-Omni only (its recipe sends guidance_scale=1); sglang's MiniMaxH3SamplingParams fixes it at 1.0 and rejects the field in a request (400). FastVideo counts sigma grid points like sglang (its docs: `--steps` 9 is nine points and eight forwards, and its denoiser rejects any other count for this checkpoint), so its request carries 9 too; it reads the rung ladder from fastvideo_inference.json and the 10/3 shifts from the scheduler configs, both present at 71a17d72. vLLM-Omni requests carry extra_params.preencode_mp4=true (2026-10-08): its documented, off-by-default overlap of MP4 encoding with the VAE decode (byte-identical frames), the counterpart of sglang's default streamed encode (#41819). Both engines run their best documented output path.

default.description: sglang's FastH3 8-Step V2 path: the checkpoint's contract selects VSA-H3 at 0.8 for the transformer; Ulysses 4, resident (speed), eager.
default.notes: #41839's cookbook command is `sglang serve --model-path FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-8-Step-V2 --num-gpus 4`; the case adds the benchmark's standing sglang flags (server warmup, speed residency, compile off -- VSA-H3 rejects torch.compile anyway). `--model-variant` must not be passed: FastH3 rejects it. Validated 2026-09-30 on 4xH200 (sglang bd66ce3 + #41839 at 8362359): 11.28 s client median in each of three arms (server total 10.46-10.54 s: denoise 8.80 s, decode 1.27 s); with #41819's overlapped MP4 encode on top, 10.89 s. 4xGB300: 8.085/8.081 s (server 6.42-6.46 s: the serial save is ~1.6 s there); with #41819, 6.97 s.

default.description: vLLM-Omni's FastH3 8-Step V2 recipe: USP 4, VAE tile patch parallel 4, FASTVIDEO_VSA (fastvideo-kernel, vllm-omni's `vsa` extra).
default.notes: The recipe's command minus host/port/served-model-name. It says not to pass --fastvideo-vsa-topk (the tile count is derived per request from the trained 80% policy). T2VA is served by the FL2VA partition. Validated 2026-09-30 on 4xH200: 12.06 s client median. The `vsa` extra's fastvideo-kernel 0.3.4 fails on H200 inside the request ('Error in tile TMA descriptor creation', then 'CUDA error: an illegal instruction was encountered'); 0.3.5 works, but its wheel declares torch==2.12.0, so a normal install downgrades vLLM 0.30's torch 2.13.0 and the server dies at startup with 'operator torchvision::nms does not exist'. Install it with --no-deps (scripts/install_comparison_frameworks.sh, VLLM_OMNI_VSA_KERNEL_SPEC). 4xGB300: 8.261/8.254 s; with extra_params.preencode_mp4 (its overlapped encode, off by default) 7.484/7.379 s. The V2 release's bundled vae/ and audio_vae/ are tensor-for-tensor the base-H3@9bfb6693 VAEs this loader fetches, so both engines decode with the same weights.

lightx2v.reason: Checked 2026-10-08 against LightX2V main 0c2edc12 (2026-10-05): LightX2V cannot serve this checkpoint under its trained contract (fastvideo_inference.json). V2 is trained for VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 at 0.8 sparsity on 64-token tiles, and LightX2V has no VSA backend (its sparse attentions -- Sparge, SVG, radial, NBHD, Sol-Attn, sparse Sage/FA4 -- are other methods; dense attention would run a different model). Its H3 scheduler builds only a uniform shifted grid from infer_steps, so the explicit rungs [999, 874, ..., 125] cannot be given (an 8-step grid starts at 1000). LightX2V's own few-step H3 paths (configs/minimax_h3/dmd/: 4- and 8-step LoRAs on the base checkpoint, mostly FP8/INT8) are a different distillation, not this checkpoint, and are not substituted.

trtllm-visual.reason: trtllm-visual's tracked scope in this harness is image cases; H3 is a video+audio model.

diffusers.reason: MiniMax-H3 is integrated as Modular Diffusers blocks only (no DiffusionPipeline), and only via an unmerged PR (huggingface/diffusers#14355 -- pip install git+.../diffusers.git@refs/pull/14355/head). Not a servable baseline path today.

default.notes: Derived 2026-10-08 from FastVideo's FastH3 V2 server config (SP4, VSA 0.8 at 64-token tiles, compile off) without its capacity switches (it offloads the text encoder and VAEs) and with #1930's lossless preset (basic_fasth3_omniref_pdd.py LOSSLESS_ACCEL_ENV at e1e25593) minus its reference memo, a cache this T2VA case cannot use. #1930/#1807's bit-identical switches are on (exact RoPE/AdaLN/SwiGLU kernels, VAE tile split, fused Ulysses all-to-all) and the output-changing ones off (FP32 round-once H3 fusions, FA4 packed varlen). The DiT is FSDP-sharded as in FastVideo's 4xH100 profile (basic_fasth3_h100.yaml): replicated, the 66.3 GB DiT, the resident 66.7 GB Qwen3-VL and the 11 GB of VAEs come to 144 GB, more than a 141 GB H200 holds. TK is the sm_90 route fastvideo-kernel takes by itself when built for 9.0a; FASTVIDEO_VSA_TK only makes it explicit. The request carries 9 sigma points = 8 forwards (case _note). default.policy_exception: Route, not speed (FastVideo main 2b164405, 2026-10-07): VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 compiles only on its sm_100a 64-token route, and fastvideo_args.py says 'other VSA routes degrade the transformer to eager with one warning', so on sm_90 the DiT runs eager whatever the switch says. Eager is also the path #1930's bit-exact kernels and heads-first tiles take.
